verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.bvnk.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as complete API documentation. Several doc citations are drawn directly from llms.txt, covering Hawk auth and partner markup fees, and the docs pages are served as raw .md files that agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit guidance on pointing agents at the docs.
